summary: Verified bug fix for Tile View drag-drop in Iron Rabbit. Removal of direction='horizontal' from the three Droppables (grouped-per-category, uncategorized, flat) in NotesApp.jsx resolves the reported jump/shift/off-screen behavior. Drag-drop in tile view now reorders correctly with no layout artifacts and no console errors. List view and grouped view unaffected.
tests_executed: Flat tile view drag-drop (index 0 → 3): Before [Test Note, Test Backend Note, Test Reminder Note, Test #4] → After [Test Backend Note, Test Reminder Note, Test #4, Test Note]. All tiles at same y=170. No off-screen tiles. Custom Order active.
Narrow viewport (780px) drag: no layout collapse, no off-screen shift. Grid kept 4 columns given tile size so single-row again — behavior clean.
Grouped tile view: data-testid=notes-icon-grouped renders correctly with 3 category buckets (Test, Test notes, Uncategorized).
List view regression: data-testid=notes-grouped renders normally with categories and notes.
Code verification: /app/frontend/src/NotesApp.jsx lines 1057, 1095, 1128 confirmed — direction='horizontal' absent from all three Droppable declarations.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: @hello-pangea/dnd default vertical/index-based collision is appropriate for wrapping CSS Grids. No handleDragEnd changes needed since it works purely off source.index → destination.index.
NotesApp.jsx is 1467 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (TileGrid, GroupedTileGrid, GroupedListView) for maintainability. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 extra notes ('Note E', 'Note F') during first session via FAB; a fresh browser context in later run had 4 test notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for tile-view drag-drop verified across flat, grouped, and cross-row scenarios. If further UX polish needed on drag animations or persistence guarantees across sort modes, revisit handleDragEnd. Cross-row drag couldn't be forced because at 780px the grid still yielded a single row for 4 tiles; to truly test wrap add 6+ notes at ~500px width.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: @hello-pangea/dnd Droppable with direction='horizontal' computes drop positions using X-axis geometry only. When the actual DOM was a wrapping CSS Grid (.notes-grid, 2-6 responsive columns, multi-row), the library's geometry assumption diverged from actual layout, producing incorrect visual reorder previews and drop positions — tiles appeared to jump upward and shift right/off-screen. Fix: removed direction prop from all three tile-view Droppables so library uses default vertical/index-based collision, which is layout-agnostic and works correctly with wrapping grids. Verified with drag from index 0 → 3 on flat tile view (Custom Order): reorder correct, no off-screen tiles, no console errors.
